f1bcc0f1be6294c99bc8e39e15067a7300fe09e6.caption: A table of typography core tokens used in the STIHL Design System, detailing font family, weight, size, and line height. Each measurement label such as 10px, 12px, 14px, and so on, refers to the specific font size in pixels. The table includes rows for different font families like "family-display-title", "family-text", and "family-text-demi", each with corresponding values and examples. Additionally, it lists font weights like "weight-regular" and "weight-bold", along with their examples. The line height section provides various line height values in pixels, such as 16px, 20px, 24px, and so on.
